episodes.title: Gachiakuta: They Threw Rudo Away... Then He Fought Back! #Shorts
episodes.script: What if the trash everyone throws away could become a weapon? In Gachiakuta, Rudo lives on the margins of a floating city, where the wealthy discard everything they no longer want. Then he's falsely accused of murder and thrown into a dangerous pit filled with monstrous creatures made from waste. He survives by discovering a strange power connected to objects people have abandoned. Joining the Cleaners gives him a chance to fight back. But Rudo isn't only battling monsters. He's confronting a world that decided some people were worthless. Would you fight to return, or build a new future? Subscribe to Otaku Reframe for more anime stories!
